story: sand-mining-crisis (styled: punctuation for pauses, emphasis, drop-offs)
lines: Sand is vanishing five times faster than in nineteen seventy... and you're standing on it.
We now mine FIFTY billion tonnes of sand and gravel a year. Five times nineteen seventy's pace!
Rivers replace just thirteen billion tonnes a year. So we're taking it... four times faster.
China pours about fifty one percent of the world's cement. Mostly? Sand and gravel.
Somehow... the beach is the crisis.
Could sand really run out? Comment below!
